scope: Dark-matter paper branch only; additive follow-up, not an overwrite of the multi-project findings register.

findings.remaining_acceptance: Predeclared spatial covariance or independent-unit model, validated weighting-search-adjusted procedure or independent-box evidence, seed/partition/multiplicity specification and coverage verification.
findings.current_action: Retain both nominal grids and all pointwise references without an upgraded physical claim.

findings.remaining_acceptance: Defensible declared missingness model or partial-identification assumptions/bounds, plus independently verified denominators and selected identities. Identity verification alone does not satisfy scientific identification.
findings.current_action: Preserve complete-case interpretation, omitted identities and exact denominators; no imputation or generalization from weighted complete cases.
